note: The freeze register. Every live screen is frozen since the date below unless it is listed under open. A frozen screen's template, fields and tags, branches, states and events do not change without an entry in unfreeze_log (date, screen, cause, what changed); copy, prices, counts, bands, scoring maps and grid values are config and are not covered. An open screen carries its reason on the page: the explicit reason here, every 'to be decided:' line on the screen, and every 'to be verified:' item that blocks it (the blocks list, per item and screen). Items not in blocks are owed: listed on the screen as owed, not as a reason. tbd_owed names the 'to be decided' lines that do not open their screen (each is a tracker row). Only a commit changes a status; the page has no control for it. scripts/apply_decisions.py writes screen.freeze from this file and fails the build when an open screen has no reason or a frozen screen carries a blocking item.
